units.name: Magyaróvár
units.note: The broad yellow Magyaróvár quarter of the 2021 city-history map, including western residential streets and the eastern riverside projection. It is not reduced to Belváros and does not copy the location of the OSM Magyaróvár label, which lies west of this source-defined footprint.

units.name: Mofém-telep
units.note: The light-blue Mofémtelep quarter in the 2021 source map. Its broad northern residential extension includes the separately named Lajta lakókert; that child estate is not aliased to this quarter.

units.name: Majorok
units.note: Broad green Majorok quarter, explicitly shown by the 2021 source, including the park and northern/eastern urban extensions. Modern Duna, Gyöngyös and Halászi estates remain potentially distinct children rather than aliases.

units.name: Moson
units.note: Orange Moson quarter from the historical-city source map. The railway-side and Mosoni-Duna-side urban perimeter is interpreted coarsely, without expanding to the full municipal area.

units.name: Városközpont
units.note: Blue Városközpont housing-estate quarter in the 2021 source map. The 2008 IVS uses a broader statistical Városközpont circuit; this packet follows the explicitly coloured 2021 quarter.

units.name: Lúcsony
units.note: Estimated northern Lucsony part of the source's combined pink Lucsony–Károlyliget quarter. The accompanying history describes Lucsony as the older settlement beside the castle and Károlyliget as its later southern garden extension. Their internal boundary is estimated around the Palánk/Kígyó street corridor; the combined parent polygon is not assigned to both names.

units.name: Károlyliget
units.note: Estimated southern Károlyliget garden-city part of the source's combined pink quarter, consistent with the historical text and the archived Károlyliget point. Internal Lucsony/Károlyliget division follows the approximate Palánk/Kígyó corridor; the parent footprint is not duplicated.
